facts.text: Under the Morningside XP Guarantee, the university guarantees students will earn their degree in four years or less and gain employment or acceptance to graduate school within six months of graduation.

sources.title: Our Guarantee | Morningside University
sources.quote: You will earn your degree in four years or less. We want you to succeed while you study with us. On-Campus Learning. You will have active, experiential learning opportunities that will build your future for after Morningside. After Graduation. You will gain employment or acceptance to grad school within six months of graduation.
